title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
**BITCOIN EVENING BRIEF**

Bitcoin closing at $77,788—down 1.6% on the day but sitting on critical support as macro conditions shift sharply in its favor.

The real story: sovereign debt crisis and exploding bond yields have structurally capped the Fed's rate hike path. Monetary policy's dead money now. That's a clean tailwind Bitcoin hasn't seen in years.

This halving's timing is brutal for fiat. Supply shock hits exactly when sovereign credibility cracks further—capital controls historically
